info.title: LFX V2 - Voting Service
info.description: Proxy service for ITX voting system

put.description:
Update a vote response using a personalized vote link token, without logging in (proxies to ITX PUT /voting/vote/{vote_id}). The ballot is identified only by the token. Omitting comment_responses preserves existing comments; including it (even empty) replaces them.

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

post.description:
Submit a vote response using a personalized vote link token, without logging in (proxies to ITX POST /voting/vote). The ballot is identified only by the token.

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

Submit a vote response (proxies to ITX POST /voting/vote)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

get.description:
Get vote response details (proxies to ITX GET /voting/vote/{vote_id})

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

put.description:
Update vote response (proxies to ITX PUT /voting/vote/{vote_id})

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

post.description:
Resend vote email (proxies to ITX POST /voting/vote/{vote_id}/resend)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

Create a new vote (proxies to ITX POST /voting/poll)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

get.description:
Get vote details (proxies to ITX GET /voting/poll/{poll_id})

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

put.description:
Update vote (proxies to ITX PUT /voting/poll/{poll_id}). Only allowed when status is 'disabled'

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

delete.description:
Delete vote (proxies to ITX DELETE /voting/poll/{poll_id}). Only allowed when status is 'disabled'

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

post.description:
Bulk resend vote email to select recipients (proxies to ITX POST /voting/poll/{poll_id}/bulk_resend)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

put.description:
Enable a vote for voting (proxies to ITX PUT /voting/poll/{poll_id}/enable)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

post.description:
Extend a vote's end time (proxies to ITX POST /voting/poll/{poll_id}/extend)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

get.description:
Get vote results (proxies to ITX GET /voting/poll/{poll_id}/results)

**Required security scopes for jwt**:
  * `manage:projects`
  * `manage:voting`

comment_responses.description: The voter's free-text responses to the poll's comment prompts. Allowed regardless of whether abstain is true — an abstaining voter skips the ballot but may still comment. Otherwise, omitting this field entirely preserves the vote's existing comments untouched; including it (even as an empty array) validates and replaces them. Each prompt_id must match one of the poll's comment prompts and must not repeat; each comment_text is required (cannot be empty after trimming) and is rejected with a 400 if longer than 5000 characters.
